Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing the purchase, storage, and administration of medications by occupational therapists.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the authority of occupational therapists topurchase, store, and administer medications; and adding a new sectionto chapter 18.59 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.59 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An occupational therapist licensed under this chapter may purchase,store, and administer medications such as hydrocortisone, fluocinonide,topical anesthetics, silver sulfadiazine, lidocaine, magnesium sulfate,zinc oxide, and other similar medications, and may administer suchother drugs or medications as prescribed by an authorized health carepractitioner for the practice of occupational therapy. A pharmacistwho dispenses such drugs to a licensed occupational therapist is notliable for any adverse reactions caused by any method of use by theoccupational therapist.
